info.title: HideMenuTiles
info.author: SudoTronics
info.description: Hide titles/homebrew from Wii U Menu
info.details: Aroma plugin that allows you to hide Titles/Homebrew icons from the Wii U Menu tile grid.\n\nPress the open-menu combo (default: L + R + D-Pad Up), which is configurable in the Aroma Config Menu to open the menu.
